## Request

Write a bridge for my song. The two verses below are a public-domain traditional text I am building on.

## Brief

A lyric is supplied and the user asks for one new section ("write a bridge"), so the AUGMENT_LYRICS row applies. Provenance is satisfied by `public_domain: true` with a `public_domain_source`. The bridge keeps the source voice (first person, present tense, plain diction), meter and couplet rhyme; the supplied verses stay verbatim.

## Supplied input

```text
[Verse 1]
The lamp is trimmed and the oil is low
The winter wind has a long way to go
I climb the stair with a steady hand
And watch for ships that will not land

[Verse 2]
The glass is clear and the night is wide
The sea lies still on the turning tide
I keep the light for the ones at sea
And the sea keeps no light for me
```
